name: hmi_get_runtime_settings
description: Read the WinCC Unified Runtime settings of an HMI: start screen (and whether that screen exists), screen resolution, auto log-off URL, central input hint/panning/zooming, bit-selection settings, language-compatible fonts, GMP and e-signature comment settings, plus the Runtime settings validation messages. Read-only.

target_name.description: Exact HMI device, device-item, or software name; required when multiple targets exist.
